capabilities: Preview a note as paginated Twitter-style cards beside the editor
Render a WeChat-style article preview that updates as you type
Export card pages or a long image as PNGs next to the note
Copy WeChat-ready rich text or save article HTML
extras: Desktop-only plugin; must be installed manually from the repository until it is listed in the community directory. README states no account, remote servers, or telemetry are involved.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to preview a note as social media cards or a WeChat-ready article while writing it in Markdown.
summary: Live preview plugin that renders Markdown notes as paginated Twitter-style cards or a WeChat-style article beside the editor, with PNG and HTML export.
